faqs.a:
(a)
Denial.
In addition to the grounds set forth in the Colorado Liquor Code and chapter 6 of
               the Arvada City Code, a common consumption area license may not be issued or renewed
               and a promotional association may not be certified if:
(1)
The applicant or licensee has violated, does not meet, or has failed to comply with
               any of the terms, conditions, or provisions of the Colorado Liquor Code or any rules
               and regulations promulgated pursuant thereto, this article V, or chapter 6 of the
               Arvada City Code;
(2)
The applicant or licensee has failed to comply with any special terms or conditions
               that were placed on its license;
(3)
The applicant has not established that the use is compatible with the reasonable requirements
               of the neighborhood or the desires of its adult inhabitants by a preponderance of
               the evidence;
(4)
There is sufficient evidence that the issuance of the license will adversely impact
               the health, welfare, or public safety of the neighborhood in which the common consumption
               area is proposed to be located;
(5)
The applicant or licensee fails to establish and maintain evidence of community support
               as required by
section 6-163
(f)(6);
(6)
The information and evidence available to and considered by the authority fails to
               reasonably establish that the proposed procedures for security and admission control
               will prevent the consumption of alcohol beverages by underage persons or prevent violations
               of open container and consumption laws;
(7)
The proposed common consumption area does not have adequate physical barriers to close
               the area to motor vehicle traffic;
(8)
The promotional association board is not composed of at least one director from each
               participating liquor licensed premises attached to the common consumption area;
(9)
The proposed premises of the common consumption area is not a single, contiguous area;
(10)
The proposed common consumption area overlaps with another common consumption area
               or any other liquor licensed premises, except the premises may overlap with a special
               event license operating in compliance with all state and local laws;
(11)
The promotional association fails to establish, by a preponderance of the evidence,
               any of the qualifications for the license at a public hearing pursuant to
section 6-164
;
(12)
The promotional association fails to submit the report required by
section 6-163
(e)(1)(iii) by January 31 of each year;
(13)
The promotional association fails to establish that the licensed premises and common
               consumption area can be operated without violating article 3 of the Colorado Liquor
               Code or creating a safety risk to the neighborhood;
(14)
The common consumption area fails to have at least two licensed premises attached
               to the common consumption area;
(15)
The promotional association fails to obtain or maintain a properly endorsed general
               liability and liquor liability insurance policy that is reasonably acceptable to the
               city clerk and names the City of Arvada as an additional insured;
(16)
A promotional association or any attached licensed premise violates C.R.S. § 44-3-910;
               or
(17)
The application fails to comply with all state and local laws, and any rules and regulations
               adopted pursuant thereto.
(
Ord. No. 4804
, § 1, 6-6-2022)
